newsitem.title: USA: Buyers line up for U.S. Stockpile aluminum.
newsitem.headline: Buyers line up for U.S. Stockpile aluminum.

text.p: Nineteen companies jostled to buy aluminum P1020 T-bars from the U.S. Stockpile's Warren location this week.
The lowest bid was from Warlock Wrecking at $755.40 per short ton, and the highest from Commercial Alloys Corp at $1,520 per short ton.

Also bidding were Metal Exchange, Sumitomo Corp, Glencore, Billiton Stratcor, Global Minerals and Metals, Brown Industries, Alcoa, J Pollock, VAW, Mitsui, Gerald Metals, Alumax, Trans-World, Reynolds Metals, Wise Metals, Tenneco Packaging, and MG Metal Commodity.
The outcome of the offer is due soon.
